content: Synthetic INC-2026-057: payment 503s delayed webhooks; retries without jitter saturated the queue. Operators enabled jittered backoff, drained deliveries, and added an age alert.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-057: callback queue saturation
metadata.impact_summary: Webhook deliveries were delayed by queue saturation.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-041: timeout retries lacked an idempotency key at authorization, causing duplicate holds. The team disabled retries, added gateway keys, and reconciled holds.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-041: duplicate authorizations
metadata.impact_summary: Some payment attempts created duplicate authorizations.

content: Synthetic INC-2025-203: checkout retried captures after timeout; downstream-only idempotency let duplicates reach the processor. Checkout now creates keys before submission.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2025-203: repeated capture requests
metadata.impact_summary: Repeated captures reached the processor as new payments.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-099: settlement slowed as concurrent jobs held overlapping ledger locks. Operators reduced concurrency, shortened transactions, and staggered batches.
Synthetic INC-2025-118: certificate rotation reopened many TLS sessions at once and raised authorization latency. A staggered pool refresh restored service.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2025-118: authorization latency after rotation
metadata.impact_summary: Authorization latency rose during certificate rotation.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-124: deployment readiness passed before downstream connections warmed, raising payment API errors. Dependency-aware probes and capped retries fixed it.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-124: deployment readiness failures
metadata.impact_summary: Payment API errors increased after a deployment.

content: Synthetic INC-2025-166: payment retries without jitter amplified a short issuer delay. Backoff jitter and a bounded queue limited repeat delivery.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2025-166: issuer delay and retries
metadata.impact_summary: Issuer delays were amplified by synchronized retries.

content: Synthetic INC-2025-171: a gateway timeout retried authorization before assigning an idempotency key. The team moved key creation to the first boundary.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2025-171: gateway retry duplicates
metadata.impact_summary: A repeated authorization request created duplicate holds.

content: Synthetic INC-2025-188: consumer restarts left too few webhook workers, delaying payment notifications. Operators restored worker capacity and added queue-age scaling.
Synthetic INC-2026-008: regional failover sent traffic before dependencies were ready, causing a brief payment outage. Readiness now checks downstream health.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-008: failover readiness gap
metadata.impact_summary: Payment traffic briefly reached an unready region.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-073: retries shared identical delays after issuer errors and flooded the payment queue. Randomized backoff restored steady processing.
Synthetic INC-2026-081: webhook backlog grew after worker concurrency was capped below incoming volume. Capacity was restored and queue alerts were added.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-081: webhook backlog
metadata.impact_summary: Webhook processing fell behind incoming events.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-112: ledger batches contended on shared payment rows during close. Smaller transactions and staggered jobs reduced lock waits.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-112: ledger close delay
metadata.impact_summary: Payment settlement jobs missed their close window.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-148: a deployment began routing payments before connection warm-up completed. Dependency-aware readiness prevented recurrence.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2026-148: cold connection rollout
metadata.impact_summary: Some payment requests failed during rollout.

content: Synthetic INC-2026-173: gateway throttling was configured below normal issuer bursts, rejecting valid payments. The team corrected limits and added load checks.
Synthetic INC-2026-184: retrying captures without gateway idempotency caused duplicate submissions. Checkout now assigns a stable key before network calls.
Synthetic INC-2026-190: a short issuer outage caused a payment retry storm because clients used fixed delays. Randomized exponential backoff eased recovery.
Synthetic INC-2024-301: a prior payment outage followed premature region failover before dependencies were healthy. It is outside the current rolling-year window.

metadata.title: Incident INC-2024-301: premature region failover
metadata.impact_summary: An unready region briefly received payment traffic.
